query:
SELECT id, name, cas_number, iupac_name, pubchem_cid
FROM molecules 
WHERE wikidata_qid IS NULL 
  AND cas_number IS NOT NULL 
  AND cas_number != ''
ORDER BY name
LIMIT 30;
